customerJourneyStories.name: From spreadsheet reconciliation to a governed data product
customerJourneyStories.summary: A public-health data lead delivers a workforce-capacity dashboard on a reusable data foundation.

stages.narrative: Leadership receives three conflicting staffing numbers during a capacity decision.
Finance, HR and scheduling definitions are mapped with owners and reconciliation rules.
Managed ingestion and a common workforce model produce the first certified dashboard within a bounded scope.
Every metric exposes source, quality state and transformation lineage; discrepancies become owned issues.
Procurement and absence use cases reuse the same people, organization and period dimensions.
Adoption and time saved justify expanding the governed platform while the organization keeps data ownership.

customerJourneyStories.name: From portal re-keying to straight-through transaction
customerJourneyStories.summary: A shared-services finance team replaces manual invoice exchange with a managed Peppol connection.

stages.narrative: Invoice volume grows while public-sector buyers require structured delivery and manual portal work creates late payments.
The team maps party identifiers, document variants, approval state and the finance-system posting workflow.
One legal entity sends and receives through the certified access point with pre-validation and visible receipts.
Business rules return actionable exceptions to finance without exposing raw payloads broadly.
More entities and document types reuse the same access-point, mapping and support model.
Straight-through rate, rejection causes and payment timing justify the recurring service and the next transaction use case.

customerJourneyStories.name: From bespoke customer projects to a supported ecosystem connector
customerJourneyStories.summary: An ISV serving municipalities replaces twelve variants with one certified connector and configuration model.

stages.narrative: A national-standard change makes twelve customer forks simultaneously unsafe.
The ISV and integration specialists compare schemas, custom rules, versions and incident histories.
A stable product contract and explicit tenant configuration replace hidden code branches.
Joint fixtures prove identity, message security, error handling and replay against the managed boundary.
The connector enters the catalog with entitlement, supported versions, dashboard and escalation map.
New customers activate in days and roadmap reviews handle upstream changes once for the ecosystem.
